(3) Wrapper pass: before staffing, `readProviderPause(store, projectId, provider, now)`; while a pause is live for the seat's provider the pass staffs NOTHING for that provider, reports `surfaceOutcome: "PROVIDER_PAUSED"`-style outcome in the RunOnceReport (name it; the idle log line at agent-wrapper-main.ts:384 prints once per distinct state), and keeps polling; the first pass at or after resetAt staffs normally.
